American political strategist and media personality Diana London has deleted posts on her X account relating to her engagement with the Nigerian government and the security partnership between Nigeria and the United States. London had earlier shared photographs of herself at the Presidential Villa, Abuja, where she was seen alongside President Bola Tinubu and his Chief of Staff, Femi Gbajabiamila. Cameras were also visible in some of the photographs. In another post, the American strategist described the security partnership between Nigeria and the United States as one that was “delivering results”. “The U.S.-Nigeria security partnership is delivering results. Peace through strength. None of this happens without the ongoing partnership between President Trump and President Tinubu, their steadfast commitment to eliminating terrorists, and Nigeria’s willingness to work closely with the U.S. government,” she wrote. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources She also suggested that the collaboration could unlock more economic and trade opportunities between the two countries. The best is yet to come. Nigeria is the United States’ greatest ally in Africa,” London stated. In a separate post, London expressed appreciation for the opportunity to work with individuals representing Nigeria, particularly on efforts to protect religious groups and strengthen relations between the Trump administration and the Nigerian government. “It has been an honour to work on the team of people representing Nigeria and helping to protect religious groups and further the relationship between the Trump administration and the Nigerian government,” she wrote. However, the posts had been deleted from her X account as of Wednesday morning, when our correspondent checked. The circumstances surrounding their removal were not immediately clear, and London had yet to publicly explain why she deleted the posts.
